verdicts.claim: No damaged record passes cleanly: of 2,000 fresh damaged records, each differing from its clean source, none is judged a pass on all eleven checks under rubric v3, and none throws.
verdicts.measured: 2000 fresh damaged records (0 could not be made different): clean passes 0, threw 0, the same judgement twice 2000

verdicts.claim: Most damage is caught by the schema itself: at least 95% of the 2,000 fail the strict P0. (Some damage leaves a record valid but incomplete, an empty list of claims for instance; C1 says those still do not pass cleanly.)

The strict schema costs nothing on good records: it passes all 500 clean and all 500 planted jobs (a badly run job is not a malformed record), the other ten checks give the same outcomes as under rubric v1 on every one of them, and every judgement is the same twice.
verdicts.measured: the strict P0 passed 1000 of 1000 clean and planted jobs; the other ten moved on 0; the same twice on 1000

verdicts.claim: The earlier holes are closed: the 3 damaged records organ 1b judged a clean pass, made again from their seeds, fail the strict P0; and every null record among the fresh damage is judged and fails P0.
verdicts.measured: the 3 records organ 1b passed cleanly: 3 now fail the strict P0; null records among the fresh damage: 23, judged and failing P0: 23
